review_summary.executive_summary: Automated Code Review for 'snippet_20261122_044436.py' (Python). Overall Code Health Score: 70.0/100 (Grade C). Identified 2 finding(s): 1 Critical, 1 High, 0 Medium, 0 Low. Verdict: Changes Requested.

critical.title: SQL Injection (SQLi) via Dynamic Query Formatting
critical.description: Dynamic SQL query construction detected using string interpolation, formatting, or concatenation. Untrusted input concatenated directly into query strings allows attackers to bypass authentication, extract database contents, or modify data.
critical.potential_impact: Allows arbitrary SQL execution. An attacker could enter `' OR '1'='1` to bypass authentication or execute `UNION SELECT` to exfiltrate private credentials.
critical.suggested_remediation: Use parameterized queries with bound placeholders (%s or ?), or leverage an ORM.

high.title: Use of Broken Cryptographic Algorithm
high.description: Usage of obsolete or vulnerable cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, or ECB mode). These algorithms suffer from collision attacks and lack integrity verification.
high.potential_impact: MD5 and SHA-1 collisions are trivial to generate. Passwords hashed with MD5 can be cracked in seconds.
high.suggested_remediation: Use SHA-256/SHA-512 for data integrity, bcrypt/Argon2 for passwords, and AES-GCM for encryption.

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Dynamic string concatenation allows unauthorized database access or extraction.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Replace query string formatting with bound parameter placeholders (%s, ?).

recommendations_for_improvement.reason: Legacy algorithms (MD5, DES, ECB) suffer known collision and predictability attacks.
recommendations_for_improvement.suggested_action: Use SHA-256 for data verification and AES-GCM or bcrypt for passwords.

final_review_summary: Review concluded with status Changes Requested. The target artifact contains 1 critical and 1 high severity security issues requiring immediate remediation.
